reason: The text contains several named characters who are not leaders. Ahinoam (אֲחִינֹעַם) and Abigail (אֲבִיגַיִל) are explicitly named as David's wives but hold no leadership positions. Nabal (נָבָל) is named as the Carmelite (deceased husband of Abigail) but is not presented as a leader. While the text does feature prominent named leaders such as Saul, David, Samuel, Achish, and Abiathar the priest, the presence of named non-leader characters (particularly David's wives) contradicts the exclusivity claimed in the statement.
